request.title: Photronics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

untrusted_blocks.text: BROOKFIELD, Conn. August 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Photronics, Inc. (NASDAQ:PLAB), a worldwide leader in photomask technologies and solutions, today reported financial results for its third quarter of fiscal year 2026 ended August 2, 2026.

GAAP Net income attributable to Photronics, Inc. shareholders was $28.9 million, or $0.49 per diluted share, compared with $22.9 million, or $0.39 per diluted share, in the third quarter of 2025 and $31.4 million, or $0.54 per diluted share, in the second quarter of 2026.

Non-GAAP Net income attributable to Photronics, Inc. shareholders was $29.4 million, or $0.50 per diluted share, compared with $29.4 million, or $0.51 per diluted share in the third quarter of 2025 and $24.9 million, or $0.42 per diluted share, in the second quarter of 2026.
IC revenue was $154.7 million, an increase of 5% both year-over-year and sequentially.
FPD revenue was $61.4 million, a decrease of 2% both year-over-year and sequentially.

notes.text: Photronics披露截至2026年8月2日的2026财年第三季度业绩。GAAP净利润约为2890万美元，稀释每股收益0.49美元；Non-GAAP净利润约为2940万美元，稀释每股收益0.50美元。IC业务收入约1.547亿美元，同比及环比均增长5%；FPD业务收入约6140万美元，同比及环比均下降2%。
公司同时提供GAAP与Non-GAAP净利润数据。Non-GAAP净利润同比持平，环比上升；GAAP净利润同比上升、环比下降。IC与FPD两大业务板块呈现相反走势，IC增长而FPD下滑。
提供的段落未包含管理层对业绩的定性解读、后续季度指引、Non-GAAP调整项目的具体构成，也未说明FPD收入下滑的原因及IC增长的主要驱动因素。完整财报共157段，当前仅选取6段，信息覆盖有限。

request.title: Nayax Enters into Definitive Agreement to Acquire IPS Group, a Leading Smart Parking Technology Provider

untrusted_blocks.text: Nayax Enters into Definitive Agreement to Acquire IPS Group, a Leading Smart Parking Technology Provider

HERZLIYA, Israel, Aug. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Nayax Ltd. (Nasdaq: NYAX; TASE: NYAX), a global commerce enablement, payments and loyalty platform, today announced a definitive agreement to acquire IPS Group, Inc. (“IPS”) from Windjammer Capital Investors in an all-cash transaction for a total consideration of $350 million.

Together, Nayax and IPS will bring together complementary capabilities in unattended commerce, pairing Nayax’s payments infrastructure and global distribution network with IPS’s purpose-built smart parking hardware and software. IPS’s two decades of field-proven technology and established base of more than 250,000 parking spaces, combined with Nayax’s reach across more than 120 countries, will accelerate IPS’s expansion into new markets, starting with Continental Europe, while giving Nayax’s existing customers access to a leading parking and curb management solution. The combination offers cross-sell opportunities and expands Nayax’s addressable cashless opportunity. It is the same playbook of land and expand Nayax has used in previous acquisitions: acquire a trusted solution provider in a vertical, then seamlessly integrate with Nayax’s own payments infrastructure to better serve our customers.
· Closing expected in Q4 2026, subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.

notes.text: Nayax（纳斯达克/TASE：NYAX）与Windjammer Capital Investors签署确定性协议，拟以全现金方式收购IPS Group。IPS是智能停车技术提供商，拥有超过二十万处停车位的部署基础。Nayax定位为全球商务赋能、支付及忠诚度平台，此次收购旨在将IPS的停车硬件与软件整合至其现有业务体系。
公司表示该交易将Nayax的支付基础设施与全球分销网络，同IPS的专用智能停车软硬件相结合，可能加速IPS向欧洲大陆等新市场扩张，并为Nayax现有客户提供停车及路侧管理解决方案。公司还提及存在交叉销售机会，并拟沿用此前收购中"获取-整合-扩展"的策略模式。
交易预计于二零二六年第四季度完成，但须获得监管批准并满足常规交割条件。由于存在审批及交割条件未满足的可能性，收购能否如期完成尚不确定。此外，提供段落未包含整合计划细节、融资来源或协同效应的具体实现路径。
